data.title: Building Bridges for the Right to Worship Act
data.description: The Las Vegas chapter of the Coalition of Hindus of North America (CoHNA) organized an interfaith event in support of bipartisan legislation. This event brought together policymakers and members of CoHNA to advocate for the bill. In addition to this, CoHNA representatives spoke in favor of the legislation during a session on Capitol Hill. The event took place on September 18, 2026, in Las Vegas.

data.title: iScreen Expands iOS 27 Customization With New Extra-Large Widget Experiences, iPhone Duo Theme Support and AI-Powered Home Screen Design
data.description: A recent announcement from iScreen, a mobile customization app for iOS and Android, highlights the introduction of new features. These include interactive extra-large widget hubs, adaptive layouts specifically designed for iPhone Duo, and AI-assisted personalization for the Home Screen. data.title: 4Humanity Introduces the National Positivity Portal, Using AI to Make the Good Happening Across America Easier to See
data.description: 4Humanity introduced the National Positivity Portal on Sept. 18, 2026, in Boston. It creates a constantly expanding archive of positive stories from across America, making them easily accessible and searchable.

data.description: CleanSpark, Inc. revealed in Las Vegas on September 18, 2026, that its subsidiary CSDC Finance I, LLC has priced a $2.276 billion offering of 7.875% senior debt securities. CleanSpark is a top data center developer listed on Nasdaq as CLSK.

data.title: Greenberg Traurig Advises Castle & Cooke in Sale of Castle & Cooke Aviation Services LLC to Signature Aviation
data.description: In Los Angeles on September 18, 2026, the leading law firm Greenberg Traurig, LLP facilitated the sale of Castle & Cooke Aviation Services LLC to Signature Aviation on behalf of Castle & Cooke, Inc.
